title: Observability: kcapi_aead encrypt/decrypt failures emit no log
description: kcapi_aead_encrypt (kcapi_aead.c:198-263) and kcapi_aead_decrypt (kcapi_aead.c:265-335) can fail via crypto_alloc_aead returning PTR_ERR (handled in sess_init), but the actual crypto_aead_encrypt/decrypt failures at lines :244 and :316 fall through to out_free_req and return ret with no log message. crypto_wait_req returning non-zero (e.g. -EBADMSG on auth tag mismatch, or a driver error) produces no ring buffer entry. A support engineer cannot distinguish a driver failure from an auth-tag mismatch from an IV problem without a debugger. The wolfssl GCM path does log at the provider level (pr_err_ratelimited for wc_AesGcmDecrypt); the kcapi path produces nothing.
